Lina (Partnerships): quick sync: CloudMarket wants to co-run a 45min roundtable + 15min live Q&A at Summit. they asked for a joint announcement the week before. need speaker confirmations, demo access, and swag plan. who can pick this up?
Tom - Events: I can own logistics. question: will speakers be onsite or remote? that changes AV + travel. also need a camera operator for the roundtable. :camera:
Priya (Marketplace): CloudMarket will send 2 speakers onsite (product + partner ops). they want the marketplace listing live same day as announcement. can Partnerships confirm listing name + 1-sentence blurb by Tue?
Diego - SI: we'll provide a short integration demo (10m). need a table with network access to our staging API and a service account key. also request 1x 4k display for UX walk-through.
Lina (Partnerships): speakers: Priya confirmed CloudMarket (Anya + Victor). Redwood speakers: Sam (PM) + Mei (Infra). can we have travel covered for Victor? partnership budget approves one-way coach + hotel.
Tom - Events: booking notes: speaker ready-room at Green Room B, mic check 30min prior, live captioning requested. I need speaker bios + slide decks by Mon.
Priya (Marketplace): listing name suggestion: "Redwood x CloudMarket: Inference at Scale". blurb: "Join Redwood and CloudMarket for a technical roundtable on serving LLMs across cloud marketplaces and enterprise ops." is that ok?
Lina (Partnerships): that wording works. Priya can you add a CTA link to our demo voucher in the listing? also need to confirm announcement embargo time.
AnnounceBot: scheduled calendar reminder created for 2026-04-15T09:00Z (announcement go-live).
Diego - SI: for demo access Ill drop a service account and a small runbook. question about secrets: can we use ephemeral tokens instead of long-lived keys on the demo laptop?
Lina (Partnerships): yes ephemeral tokens preferred. Engineering will generate short-lived demo creds (TTL 4 hours). Sam + Mei please coordinate with Diego.
Tom - Events: swag question: do we ship co-branded stickers + 300 promo cards? customs forms for international shipments need HS codes & values. Ops please confirm by Thu.
Priya (Marketplace): CloudMarket can supply 200 co-branded stickers and 150 promo codes. they will ship from EU warehouse. provide shipping address to CloudMarket ops.
Lina (Partnerships): action items:\n- Priya: confirm listing copy + CTA link by Tue\n- Tom: AV + captioning + camera operator booked by Wed\n- Diego: service account and runbook + ephemeral token flow by Thu\n- Sam (Redwood PM): slides + 2-min demo script by Mon\n- Mei (Infra): generate demo creds and health-check endpoint `/status` by Thu
AnnounceBot: checklist created:
```
- speakers: Anya (CloudMarket), Victor (CloudMarket), Sam (Redwood), Mei (Redwood)
- deck deadline: Mon 09:00 local
- shipping: stickers/cards -> inbound by Fri
- AV: 1x 4k display, 1x camera operator, captioning
- demo infra: ephemeral tokens, `/status` endpoint, staging URL
- announcement: embargo lift 2026-04-15T09:00Z
```
Tom - Events: scheduling 20min dry-run day-before in Green Room B. can everyone save that slot?
Priya (Marketplace): noted. CloudMarket ops will also join the dry-run to test marketplace voucher redemption flow.
Lina (Partnerships): great. last ask: if announcement leaks early we push to plan B: move listing to private beta and delay social posts by 24h. tagging everyone for visibility. :eyes:
